commission.label: Igipimo cy’iduka (%)
commission.help: Kugeza ku mibare ibiri nyuma y’akadomo, kuva kuri 0 kugeza ku 100. Siga ubusa kugira ngo hakoreshwe igipimo rusange. Gikurikizwa ku byatumijwe guhera ubu.
commission.invalid: Andika ijanisha kuva kuri 0 kugeza ku 100, rifite kugeza ku mibare ibiri nyuma y’akadomo.

confirmBody.approved: Iduka rirafunguka: ibicuruzwa byaryo bikora bigaragara ku rubuga kandi nyiraryo agakoresha ikibaho cy’umucuruzi. Nyiraryo yoherezwa imeri.
confirmBody.rejected: Nyiraryo abona impamvu yawe kandi ashobora guhindura ubusabe akongera kubwohereza. Nyiraryo yoherezwa imeri.
confirmBody.suspended: Ibicuruzwa by’iduka bihita bihishwa kandi ntibicuruzwe, kandi nyiraryo ntashobora gukoresha ikibaho cy’umucuruzi. Ibyamaze gutumizwa ntibihinduka. Nyiraryo yoherezwa imeri irimo impamvu yawe.
confirmBody.reinstate: Iduka rirongera rirafunguka: ibicuruzwa byaryo bigaragara ku rubuga kandi nyiraryo agakoresha ikibaho cy’umucuruzi. Nyiraryo yoherezwa imeri.

analytics.title: Isesengura na raporo
analytics.description: Uko isoko riri gutera imbere: igurisha, komisiyo, amaduka n'abakiriya muri buri gihe. Imibare rusange gusa; nta makuru y'umukiriya cyangwa y'itumiza.
analytics.growthHelp: Amatumiza yishyuwe, abarwa ku munsi w'ubwishyu bwa mbere bwagenze neza (isaha ya Kigali).
analytics.noSales: Nta kintu cyagurishijwe muri iki gihe.
